91559fdcd426cd8fa922a9d49025036b4e9757d5: Chamrousse offers 83 km of well-marked runs, a mid-sized ski area that is ideal for spending 4 to 5 days without ever doing exactly the same thing twice. The 17 lifts are generally sufficient to handle the crowds in peak season. Chamrousse's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, a well-organised childcare service, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. Chamrousse's altitude (1,650 m at the base, 2,250 m at the top) allows it to maintain decent snow cover in the middle of winter. January and February are the most reliable; in December and March, it is worth checking conditions before finalising a booking. The day lift pass at 44€ places Chamrousse among the mid-range resorts on budget: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and its facilities justifies this price for most skiers. In short: Chamrousse keeps its promises. A resort in the Northern Alps that will suit most profiles without disappointing.
